name: Kagami Yukino
source:
She is the older sister of Akira Kagami. She is a seductive woman who is the manager of a secret members-only club. She is the mistress of the club owner. However, Yukino only loves Akira. As long as she has Akira, she doesn't need anything else. She is both sadistic and masochistic.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.ail-soft.com/pro_mesunie_cha_4.htm]official site[/url]]
